properties.site-address: Welwyn Garden City - Land north of The Beehive PH Beehive Lane
properties.notes: The freeholder of the site is a public authority, but the site also has an outstanding lease to a private body for a period in excess of 15 years - that private body is therefore also an owner in accordance with Regulation 4 of the Brownfield Land Register Regulations 2017. As such, the site has mixed ownership.
